features.source: 6A futures return minus beta-adjusted GC,HG,SI basket return
features.availability_instant: After session close (all futures data available after close)
features.formula: residual_6A_t = ret_6A_t - beta_6A_t * (equal_weighted_sum(ret_i_t for i in ['GC', 'HG', 'SI']))
features.name: residual_6A
